decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than 25 September 2021

Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
description: Variation of conditions 2, 15, 16, 17, 18, 21, 23, 24 and 25 of approved permission 5988/16 and Conditions 1 and 2 of approved Non-Material Amendment 5988/16/09: To amend plans under this Section 73 application to provide 18 additional flats (from 177 to 195 flats), simplify building massing, remove basement parking area, increase height of tower from 12 to 13 storeys and Eastern Avenue frontage block from eight to nine storeys and add a community room (Use Class F2) on ground floor corner. (summary)
